text:
I built the lower third as four layers on a 6 s comp: **Lower third panel**, **Accent line**, **Name** ("Dr. Amelia Hart") and **Title** ("Head of Research, Larkspur Labs"). Everything uses Quart In Out, and the piece is clear by 5.7 s.

- **Panel:** translucent blue-grey (#1c2733 at 60%) slides in 60 px from the left and fades in from 0.2 s.
- **Accent line:** a thin 3 px line grows from its left edge from 0.6 s.
- **Name and title:** each fades up 24 px and 16 px, starting at 0.9 s and 1.15 s. The soft reveal is opacity plus slide, not a true mask.
- **Hold:** about 2.9 s with the full lockup visible.
- **Out:** text drifts up and fades (4.85–5.35 s), the accent line retracts to its left edge, and the panel slides out to the left, finishing at 5.7 s.

I set the comp background to a placeholder dark slate (#2a3440) so the panel reads. Swap it for the interview footage.

The critic scored this 63/100 and asked for Expo/Quart Out entrances and shorter slides. I kept the long in-out easing because you asked for it. The hold is intentional reading time.

If you want, I can make the entrances decelerate harder, add a lower-contrast variant, or create a version with a left-aligned accent bar instead of the horizontal line.
